public_note: This Noether Paper 25 RA70 package is a narrow source-header and footnote-placement repair candidate, not a whole Paper 25 certification.

files.quality_label: Noether Paper 25 RA70 German source-header/footnote-placement repair candidate
files.coverage: Paper 25, Eliminationstheorie und Idealtheorie, J. Ber. d. DMV 33 (1924), printed pp.116-120. The package contains a German cumulative TeX/PDF/log candidate, RA69-to-RA70 diff, GDZ article source PDF, GDZ structure/canvas maps, raw-image inventory, one 1000dpi inspection witness, fix/disposition CSVs, method note, README, and checksums.
files.findings: The source has the subtitle/occasion line `Vortrag, gehalten in Marburg am 25. September 1923.` with source footnote marker `1)`, followed by `Von Emmy Noether in Göttingen.` The cumulative TeX omitted those source header lines and attached the footnote to the first body sentence. RA70 inserts a Paper 25 footnote reset, restores the subtitle/occasion and author lines, and moves the existing footnote text to the source subtitle marker. No mathematical or body prose content changed. XeLaTeX compiled successfully with a 432-page output.
files.limitations: Targeted source-apparatus/header repair evidence only. It does not certify every Paper 25 formula or prose line, does not promote a unified German branch, and does not propagate to English, Spanish, Japanese, French, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, or Interslavic branches.
